pages.raw_meta: Our Mission  We believe every person has the potential to be amazing. And that there’s a better way to bring out what they already have in them.   We know…
raw_blocks: Skillsoft is an AI-native skills management platform that helps enterprises see workforce capability clearly, close skill gaps, and prove outcomes.
We believe skills fuel growth. For organizations. For learners. For whatever comes next.

At Skillsoft, our mission is to empower every organization and every learner to turn constant change into continuous growth. We do that by helping customers understand what skills matter, build real capability through learning, and move forward with confidence as work evolves. This belief is grounded in decades of learning expertise and shaped by what leaders and learners need today: clarity, readiness, and progress they can see and feel.
Get to know the board members who help guide our strategy, oversight, and long-term growth. Our investor site has full bios and the latest company details.
Our teams are growing fast and looking for amazing people to join us. We have an open, collaborative workspace where we encourage camaraderie and celebrate teamwork.
We're here for you at our locations across the globe — from North America to Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia-Pacific region.
